hours: We take orders from 9am to 5pm, and we also work on Sundays when an order comes in.
notice: You can order the same day, within our order hours.
delivery: Yes, we deliver anywhere the order is placed. The delivery fee depends on the rider and your location, so we'll confirm it with you when you order.
payment: Payment is by bank transfer. We'll send the account details when you place your order.
flavours: We offer our standard parfait, with no flavour options at the moment.
